dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: You have a point. Surely there isn't a single spot in all Natlan livelier than the Chuwen Fair?

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Oh... The People of the Springs doesn't count. The people and Saurians back where I'm from are all busy bathing in the hot springs. Aside from Mualani, you could count those who take their business seriously on a hand or two.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: And even Mualani spends all day away from the store anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Hehe, come to think of it, someone like me would already be considered a hard worker back in my hometown.
